findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_trip" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns, for the inputs that are present: destination advice for a country (US State Department, UK FCDO and Canada, side by side), active disaster alerts, weather for the city being visited, CDC travel health notices, public holidays between two dates, and an exchange rate; the cheapest round-trip " → after: "Returns, for the inputs that are present: destination advice for a country (US State Department, UK FCDO and Canada, side by side), active disaster alerts, weather for the city being visited (pass city; defaults to the capital), CDC travel health notices, public holidays between two dates, and an ex"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
